sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis mi 'gal na// tshangs pa'i yul la dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon// yod par 'dod pa'i 'jig rten ci'i phyir 'gog /ces brjod pa'ang shin tu mi rigs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs gsungs pa ni gdul bya'i khams dang bag la nyal ma lus par mkhyen nas gsungs pa yin la/ tshangs pa la sogs pa rnams kyis ni rang nyid kyi gnas tshul kyang mi shes na/ gzhan lta ci smos/ de nyid kyi ngor bden pa tsam la 'dod na ni skra shad 'dzag snang gi dbang shes kyis skyon med kyi dbang po sun 'byin pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i bslad pa zhugs pa'i shes pas ye shes sun 'byin par ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro// gal lte khyod kyis/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i tha snyad tsam yang dgag par 'dod na shin du nas kyang tha chad par 'gyur te/ bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa thob pa'i skyes mchog du ma la tshad mar mchog tu grub pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ rdo rje de ni rdo rje sems// rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang*// he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo// dang po'i sangs rgyas thub pa che// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rnam bzhag 'di 'thad par grub cing*/ de nyid phyi rol du ji ltar grub pa bzhin du rnal 'byor pa'i lus la'ang gnas par 'dod dgos pa yin te/ de skad du yang bsdus rgyud las/ 'khor lo can ni rang gi lus la rdo rje can te lha mchog bdag rnams yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog /rigs ldan dag ni yang dag ye shes glang po rta dang shing rta mngag gzhug 'phags pa'i tshad de rnams// drag po rang rgyal ming can du 'gyur hā nu ma ni nyan thos dag ste gdug pa kla klo'i dbang*// srog chags rnams kyi sdig pa dag ste gang zhig byed pa'i blo gros sdug bsngal sbyin byed mi dge'i lam// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

yang de nyid las/ sa yis sra la chu yis gsher zhing me yis dro bar 'gyur te rlung gis kyang ni yang ba nyid// bu ga stong ba brtan pa rus pa nyid dam lha yi rigs mchog 'dir ni char pa bdud rtsir 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa rnams kyi don ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i lus las gzhan du phyi 'jig rten gyi khams ma grub cing srid pa gsum dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnal 'byor pa'i lus la tshang bar bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ lus la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad spro ba dang bsdu ba la dbang 'byor bar bya ba'i don dang*/ phyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang nang rdo rje'i lus dang gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams gcig tu go bar bya ba'i phyir du/ rnal 'byor ba'i lus la srid gsum mtha' dag tshang bar bstan pa ni dgos pa yin pas so// gnyis pa le'u bdun pa ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul la/ dngos dang*/ le'u'i mtshan bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas ji ltar nang gi lus// phyi rol ji bzhin gnas pa ni// khams gsum nang gi bdag nyid de// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rnam shes dang ye shes gzhi lam 'bras bu 'brel ba bshad pa'i rjes de nas/ dus 'khor las gsungs pa ji lta bar nang rdo rje'i lus la yang*/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnas lugs ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gling bzhi ri rab la sogs pa gnas pa ni/ khams gsum po thams cad na rdo rje'i lus kyi bdag nyid yin pa de'i phyir/ lus las tha dad pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du ma grub bo zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ srid pa sum cu so gcig dang sbyar te bshad/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang sbyar te bshad/ ri rnams dang sbyar te bshad/ gling rnams dang sbyar te bshad/ 'byung ba lnga dang sbyar te bshad/ mtsho bdun dang sbyar te bshad/

gza' la sogs pa rnams dang sbyar te bshad/ me gsum dang sbyar te bshad/ skye gnas bzhi dang sbyar te bshad/ bdud rtsi'i char dang sbyar te bshad/ thun dang dus sbyor dang sbyar te bshad/ nang gi rten 'brel la brten nas zla nyi sgra gcan rtogs pa'i tshul dang bcu gnyis las/ dang po la/ gnas gzhan nyi shu dang sbyar te bshad pa dang*/ 'dod pa bcu gcig dang sbyar te bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyi bo nas ni sor bzhi po// gzugs med gnas te de 'og tu// sor ni bcu drug gzugs khams nyid// ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje'i lus la gru bzhi dang*/ phyi 'jig rten gyi khams la 'bum phrag bzhir byas pa la/ phyi'i 'bum phrag re dang*/ nang gi khru re mthun par dag pa sbyar ba ste/ nang du khru re re la sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi re yod cing*/ de'ang*/ lus kyi lte ba yan chad kyi khru do la ni mi dang lha rnams gnas pa yin la/ de man chad la ni lha ma yin dang klu dang yi dwags dang dmyal ba rnams gnas pa yin pas phyir ri rab dang*/ nang lus kyi spyi bo nas sor bzhi na gzugs med pa'i khams bzhi'o// de yang glad pa'i steng du thod pa la ma reg pa'i stong pa'i cha bzhi la byed do// spyi bo de'i 'og nas ri rab dang*/ lus kyi gdong gi cha sor bcu drug ni gzugs kyi khams gnas ris bcu drug go /gnyis pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de 'og 'dod lha mir bcas pa// lte ba nas ni rkang mthil bar// lha min klu dang yi dwags dang*// dmyal ba brgyad kyi gnas rim gsungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de'i 'og nas mgrin pa'i bar du sor bzhi ni 'dod pa'i lha rigs drug gi gnas dang*/ de'i 'og tu lte ba'i bar du brang gi cha thams cad ni mi thams cad kyi gnas yin no// lte ba nas sum mdo'i bar du ni phyi rol du sa'i dkyil 'khor mtshon te/ dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed yin pa las phyed gong ma ni lha ma yin dang klu'i gnas dang*/

yi dwags ni ci rigs par gnas la/ phyed 'og ma ni gseg ma chu'i dmyal ba gnas shing*/ 'di ni dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad do// brla ni chu'i dkyil 'khor ste// bye ma chu'i dmyal ba dang*// 'dam gyi chu'i dmyal ba'o// rje ngar ni me ste mi zad pa du ba'i dmyal ba dang*/ me'i dmyal ba gnyis gnas so// de man chad ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ drag po'i rlung chen po'am mun pa'i dmyal ba dang*/ ngu 'bod mun pa chen po'i dmyal ba gnyis gnas so// rkang mthil du ni brgyad pa rdo rje'i dmyal ba'i gnas rnams rim pa bzhin du gsungs pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rkang lag tshigs gsum rim pa ltar// rlung me chu yi dkyil 'khor yin// brang ni sa ste/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rkang pa'i tshigs/ dpyi dang pus mo dang long bu'i tshigs gsum/ lag pa'i phrag pa dang gru mo dang 'khrig ma'i tshigs gsum rnams/ phyogs thams cad du 'khor ba'i phyi nas rim pa ltar/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyar 'bum phrag bzhi/ me'i dkyil 'khor la gsum/ chu la gnyis/ sa la gcig yod pa'i 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams yin no// brang ni 'bum phrag cig yod pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor yin no// gsum pa ri rnams bstan pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgal tshigs ni/ ri rab de bzhin ri bdun ni// brla dang rje ngar de 'og rus// dpung pa lag ngar lag pa dang*// sen mo'i bar du rim pa ltar// sngon po man+dha ra mtshan mo// nor bu'i 'od dang bre bo dang*// kha ba can dang rdo rje'i ri// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sgal tshigs ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab bo// zhes pa ste/ de'ang nang du ltag tshigs pa nas rkub chung ba'i bar ni/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi gdong pa dang mgrin pa ma gtogs pa'i lus dngos gzhi'o// zhes pa'i don no// de'i 'khor yug gi ri chen po bdun ni nang nas rim pa bzhin du/

brla'i rus pa ni mdog sngon can gyi ri'o// rje ngar gyi rus pa ni man+dha ra'o// bol gong gi rus pa ni mtshan mo'i ri'o// dpung pa'i rus pa ni nor bu'i 'od do// lag ngar gyi rus pa ni bre bo'i ri'o// lag mgo'i rus pa ni kha ba can no// sen mo rnams ni rdo rje'i ri ste 'khor yug gi ri yin no// 'di ni phyi rol gyi rta gdong gi me 'am/ rgod ma kha'i me'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhag ma mtshon pa yin no// de ni phyi rol rdo sol gyi ri dang chu 'phrod pa yin par grags so// bzhi pa gling rnams bshad pa la/ nang gi gling drug dang sbyar te bshad pa dang*/ phyi rol gyi gling bcu gnyis dang sbyar te bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gling drug nang na bad kan dang*// rgyu ma tshil snying mchin pa sha// zla ba dkar po ku sha dang*// mi'am ci dang khrung khrung gling*// drag po'i gling rnams rim pa ste// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ nang gi gling drug ni/ 'khor yug gi ri rnams kyi rtsa bar rim pa bzhin du gnas te/ de nang la sbyar na/ lus kyi bad kan gyi khams ni zla ba'i gling ngo*// rgyu ma ni dkar po'i gling ngo*// tshil ni ku sha'i gling ngo*// snying ni mi 'am ci'i gling ngo*// mchin pa ni khrung khrung gi gling ngo*// sha ni drag po'i gling ste/ de dag ni nang gi gling drug go// gnyis pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rkang lag dum bu bcu gnyis ni// 'dzam bu'i gling sogs gling phran bcas// shes so// gnyis pa ni/ de la lag pa g.yas pa'i dum bu gsum ni lus 'phags kyi gling ngo*// de bzhin du/ g.yon pa'i dum bu gsum ni 'dzam bu'i gling ngo*// rkang pa g.yon pa'i dum bu gsum ni ba glang spyod kyi gsum mo// g.yas pa'i dum bu gsum ni byang sgra mi snyan gyi gsum mo// des na/ gong du ri drug po'i skabs su bshad pa'i brla dang dpung pa la sogs pa rnams ni rus pa'i cha yin la/

'dir bshad pa rnams ni sha'i kham tshad kyi cha yin par shes na go bde bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa 'byung ba lnga la sbyar te bshad pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sra ba rlan dang drod dang dbugs/ khams bzhi bu ga nam mkha' yin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de la lus kyi sra ba'i cha rnams ni sa dang rlan pa ni chu dang drod rnams ni me dang dbugs 'byung ba dang 'jug pa rnams ni rlung ste khams bzhi po rnams yin la/ lus kyi mig rna ba sna dang kha dang 'og sgo'i bu ga rnams ni nam mkha'i khams su bsdus pa yin te/ zhes pa'o// drug pa mtsho bdun dang sbyar ba la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khu ba zhag dang glad pa dang*// bad kan 'o ma mchil ma rdul// dri chu nang gi rgya mtsho bdun// sbrang rtsi mar zho 'o ma chu// chang dang ba tshwa'i rang bzhin no// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gling rnams kyi nang du rim pa bzhin du gnas pa las nang du sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho ni khu ba'o// mar gyi rgya mtsho ni zhag go /zho'i rgya mtsho ni mgo'i glad pa'o// 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ni bud med rnams kyi 'o ma dang skyes pa rnams kyi bad kan gyi khams so// chu'i rgya mtsho ni mchil ma'o// chang gi rgya mtsho ni rdul lo// phyi rol du ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho ni nang du gcin no// 'dir/ gzhan rnams ni gling rnams kyi nang du yin kyang*/ ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho ni 'dzam gling chen po'i phyi rol du 'dod dgos te/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dang don gcig pa'i phyir ro// bdun pa gza' la sogs pa la sbyar te bshad pa la/ gza' dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ sprin dang*/ nye ba'i gza' dang sbyar ba bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dbang po gza' dgu'i rang bzhin te// zhes pa ni/ nang du mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams ni/ phyi rol du gza' dgu'i rang bzhin te/ de yang sna bug gnyis ni/ rlung gi gza' nyi ma dang zla ba'o// mig gnyis ni me'i gza' lhag pa dang bkra shis so// kha dang dri chu'i sgo gnyis ni chu'i gza' pa ba sangs dang phur bu'o// dri chen dang spyi gtsug gi bu ga gnyis ni/

sa'i gza' spen pa dang mjug rings so// rna ba'i bu ga gnyis ni nam mkha'i gza' sgra gcan dang dus me'o// 'ga' zhig tu gza' bcur bshad pas// 'dir dgu'i rang bzhin du bshad pas mi 'thad ce na/ 'gal ba med de/ sgra gcan dang dus me gnyis po gza' gcig gi rang bzhin du 'dus pa'i phyir te/ sgra gcan mgo dang dus me ni 'jug ma la ming btags pas so// gzhan yang snying ga'i rtsa bcu la gza' bcu'i rang bzhin du bshad pa yang yod pas 'gal ba nyid du sems par mi bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ so ni rgyu skar rtsa chu'o// zhes pa ste/ nang du so rnams ni rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin no// phyi'i chu bo rnams ni nang du rtsa thams cad du khams 'bab pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rgyu ma sprin dang nang gi rlung*// zhes pa ste/ 'di'i don yang*/ phyi rol gyi sprin ni nang du rgyu ma yin la/ chos mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phyi rol du sprin gyis chu 'dzin pa ltar/ nang du rgyu mas ro 'dzin cing 'dzag pa'i phyir/ phyi'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni nang du lus la gnas pa'i rlung rnams so// bzhi pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snying ga'i sgra ni thog yin te// lto ba'i sgra ni 'brug tu gsungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol du nye ba'i gza' thog ni nang du snying ga las byung ba'i sgra'o// nang du lto ba'i sgra ni phyi rol du nye ba'i gza' 'brug go /brgyad pa me gsum bshad pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snying ga mgrin pa lte ba na// glog dang nyi drod bsreg byed me// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ snying gar ni glog gi me ste zhe sdang bskyed par byed pa'o// 'di ni phyi rol du nye ba'i gzar dbang phyug chen pos bshad do// mgrin par ni nyi ma'i me ste bya ba byed pa'i me'o// lte bar sha za'i me ste zas bsreg par byed pa'i don to// dgu pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/

dang po ni/ gzhan yang lpags pa drod dang spu// me dang rlung gi rang bzhin no// lus skyes srin bu skye gnas bzhi// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gong du bstan pa de dag las/ gzhan yang*/ lus kyi lpags pa dang drod dang*/ spu thams cad ni me dang rlung gi rang bzhin yin no// lus la skyes pa'i srin bu'i rigs thams cad ni phyi rol du skye gnas bzhi bcas yin te/ phyir rlung gi khams sgong skyes ni nang du shig go// phyi rol du chu'i khams drod gsher las skyes pa ni/ lus kyi nang gi srin bu rnams yin no// phyir me'i khams mngal skyes ni nang du khams dkar dmar las skyes pa rnams so// phyi rol du nam mkha'i khams rdzus te skyes pa ni nang du lus la 'byung ba'i srog chags phra mo gzhan rnams so// bcu pa ni/ char ni lce chung bdud rtsi ste// zhes gsungs pa yin la// 'dir yang phyi rol du char pa ni/ nang du lce'u chung nas 'bab pa'i bdud rtsi'i khams yin no// zhes pa'o// bcu gcig pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun nas skad cig bar gyi ni// dus sbyor thams cad sngar bstan pa'i// rtsa rlung thig le sems bcas so// de sogs rnam bshad du ma rnams// phyi nang gzhan gsum ye shes so// sbyor phyir dpag tu med pa gsungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ thun chen po bzhi dang brgyad kyi dbye ba nas/ skad cig dang yud tsam la sogs pa'i bar gyi ni 'pho ba che chung gi dus sbyor thams cad ni/ rtsa rlung thig le sems bcas las 'byung bar sngar gong du rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i gnas skabs su ji skad bstan pa ltar yin no// sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang sngar rtsa'i gnas skabs su sgra gcan dang sbyar nas bshad pa rnams so// de dag la sogs pa'i phyi nang gi dag pa sbyar ba'i rnam bshad rnams ni/ phyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang nang rdo rje'i lus dang gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/

thams cad la khyab byed du 'jug pa ye shes kyi khams su bstan pa'i phyir phyi nang gzhan gsum dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa dpag tu med pa rnams/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pas/ gong gi de tsam gyis go bas na 'dir rgyas par ma spros so// bcu gnyis pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ srog rlung dkar dmar sbyor ba na// zla nyi 'dzin par snang ba dang*// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad mthun pa'i don gyis na/ nang du srog gi rlung la/ g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rlung gnyis dang khams dkar dmar gnyis po dbu ma'i nang du srog rlung la reg pa de'i tshe na/ phyi rol du dus sbyor gyi mtshams kyi mtha'/ rdul mun pa snying stobs kyi dus gsum dang*/ gza' 'dzin byung ma thag pa'i dbyar nyi log nas zla ba drug dang*/ dgun nyi log nas zla ba drug gi mthar gza' 'dzin 'byung ba nang gi rten 'brel las rtogs pa'am/ yang na/ sngar zla ba la sgra gcan zhugs nas zla ba drug song ba'i rjes su slar yang de la sgra gcan 'jug pa nang gi srog rlung dkar dmar gyi rten 'brel las rtogs pa dang*/ nyi ma la sgra gcan zhugs nas/ zla drug song ba'i rjes la slar yang sgra gcan 'jug pa nang gi rten 'brel las rtogs pa lta bu ni/ phyi nang gnyis po rten 'brel mthun par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs su 'gyur te/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ dkar nag gi tshigs mtshams su rten 'brel reg pa'i dbus der sgra gcan gyis zla ba nyi ma'i rkang pa la 'dzin pa dang*/ nang du srog rlung la dkar dmar gyis reg cing rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i rnam 'gyur cung zad cig 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i tshe dge ba gang byas stobs che bar gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no// 'di dag ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud las/ sa dang chu me rlung dang rdo rje lha yi gzhu dang rlung rnams dang ni khyim gyi 'khor lo dang*// zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan lhun po gdengs can mi dang lha yi gnas dang 'khyog po skar mar bcas// 'pho ba zla ba dag dang phyogs dang nyi

na dang mtshan mo tshes rnams mtha' dag lus kyi dbus su ni// rang rang yi ges shes bya rnam gsum khyab bdag bgrod pa rnal 'byor pa yi stong pa'i dbye bas so// zhes pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs 'grel las/ ji ltar phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i tshad kyi lhun po'i dpangs dpag tshad 'bum yin no// de bzhin du lus kyi sgal tshigs kyi dpangs khru gang ste khru'i tshad des lus ni khru bzhi'o// lhun po dpag tshad 'bum gyi tshad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag bzhi'o// rnam pa gzhan du na/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin lus su mi 'gyur te mi mnyam pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don no// gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ de sogs rten 'brel rtogs pa na// thabs dang shes rab sbyor shes pas// sna tshogs yon tan 'byung phyir ro// 'dir ni mdor bsdus cung zad brjod// ces pa ste/ 'di yang*/ de ltar ji skad bshad pa la sogs pa'i rten 'brel rtogs pa na/ phan tshun thabs dang shes rab dang kun rdzob dang don dam dang lus dang bsam pa dang yul dang yul can la sogs pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnas lugs shes nas/ rang bzhin med pa'i don khong du chud pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ba de'i phyir/ 'dir ni phyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang nang rdo rje'i lus dang gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang gsum po la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi gnas lugs mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig brjod pas/ de nyid kyi lha dang sngags dang dkyil 'khor gyi don yang rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las snod la sbyar ba bstan pa ste bdun pa'o// zhes so// srid pa so gcig dkyil 'khor ri mtshor bcas// gza' dgu rgyu skar sprin dang skye gnas bzhi// srog rlung sbyor bas sgra gcan 'jug tshul dang*// thabs shes sbyor ba'i gnas lugs legs par bshad// ces pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba las snod la sbyar ba rnam par bshad pa ste bdun pa'o//

༈ //brgyad pa kun btags kyi lha bskyed tshul bstan pa'i le'u la/ dngos dang*/ le'u'i mtshan bstan pa rnam pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po la/ spyi'i don dang*/ yan lag gzhung gi don rnam pa gnyis/ dang po spyi'i don la/ gong ma dang mtshams sbyar ba'i sgo nas bskyed rim bstan pa'i dgos pa bshad/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ji ltar sgom pa'i rnam grangs bstan pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar nang rdo rje'i lus dang*/ phyi 'jig rten khams sbyar bshad bstan pa'i rjes de nas/ kun btags kyi lha sgom pa'i bskyed rim gyi tshul 'chad pa la dgos pa yod pa yin te/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i gnas lugs bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na bskyed rim ni/ kun rtog gis btags pa tsam yin pas/ don la ma grub bzhin du sgom pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ yod de/ dgos pa rnam pa gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ sngags la 'jug pa'i las dang po pa rnams kyis/ sems ma zin pa zin par byed pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ bskyed rim gyi rten dang brten pa'i sbyar bshad la mkhas na phyi nang gi shes bya'i don shin du phra ba rnams re re la'ang*/ phyi rol rten gzhal yas khang dang nang lha'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sbyar bshad shes pa'i don dang*/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la zhen pas zhugs pa'i rjes su 'brel bas mi slu bas/ ma 'ongs pa na 'bras bu grub pa'i gnas skabs na/ gzhan ngor gzugs kyi sku zhal phyag mang po dang*/ nyung ngu dang sku mdog dang*/ rtags dang cha lugs sna tshogs pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pa sten pa la dbang 'byor pa'i sgo nas/ rang rang gi khams dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo phyogs med du bskor nus pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ rang rgyud kyi tha mal gyi lus 'di la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spangs nas/

dag snang lha'i skur go ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ des na/ sngags la 'jug pa la/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang dgos shing*/ de'i rjes su lam gyi gzhung shing ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis po yin te/ de skad du yang*/ he badz+ra las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni// rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid// rim gnyis rnam par gnas nas ni// rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do// zhes pa dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lung*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis rim pa lnga'i gzhung du drangs pa las/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs// shes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chos thams cad spros bral du sgom dgos par gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ de skad du yang he badz+ra las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa sgom// spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas// spros pa nyid ni spros med byed// ces gsungs shing*/ de'i 'grel par rdo rje snying pos/ thog ma nyid du spros pa'i rnal 'byor la 'bad bar bya'o// de yang ji skad du/ sems can rnams ni blo dman zhing*// bya ba tsam gyis rmongs pa rnams// dngos po'i don la chags dga' ba// ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur// 'di lta'i tshul ni mi shes pas// yul dang dus dang bya ba las// dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma yis// rmongs pa 'bras bus 'dod byed de// sems dpa' chen pos de dag phyir// cho ga 'di ni brjod pa yin// zhes so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang por de ltar bsgoms kyang*/ rjes su spros med du bsgoms pas mtshan 'dzin du mi 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ brtag gnyis las/ ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam dang*// ji ltar bar ma'i srid yin pa// rtag tu goms pa'i sbyor ba yis// dkyil 'khor nyid ni de bzhin 'dod// ces bya ba dang*/

de'i rdo rje snying 'grel du/ rdzogs pa 'di ni rang gi lha'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid sgyu ma dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ srid pa bar ma do'i skye bo ltar chags pa dang*/ thogs pa dang bral bar sgom pa nyid rdzogs pa zhes 'dod de/ 'dod pa spong ba'i phyir/ so sor spang ba zhes bshad cing*/ zhes gsungs pas so// gnyis pa bskyed rim sgom pa'i tshul la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ma rgyud rnams las/ pho brang rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag /mchod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag /bstod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag /rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag dang drug tu gsungs te/ a wa dhu tī pas mdzad pa'i kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs su/ pho brang rnam par snang mdzad de// rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems// dbang ni mi bskyod rdo rje dag /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med// ces sogs gsungs pa dang*/ grub chen mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i kye'i rdo rje'i 'grel par/ rjes chags dang dbang bskur ba'i 'og tu/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ dag pa dang rjes su dran par bya ste/ zhes gsungs/ yang ma rgyud la lar/ dang po'i sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog dang*/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang lngar bshad pa dang*/ yang la lar/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ nye bar bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po dang bzhir bshad pa yang yod de/ dper na mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa lta bu'o// yang ma rgyud kyi gzhung la lar// dang por rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang nas/ 'khor bskyed pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar du ni gong bu'i rnal 'byor dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi chags pas zhu nas chur gnas pa dang*/ rgyas gdab kyi bar gzugs su gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor du bsdu ba gzugs las 'das pa ste/

yan lag bzhir bskyed pa'i tshul yang bshad de/ de skad du/ gong bu chu dang gzugs su gnas// gzugs las 'das pa bzhir rtogs bya// zhes gsungs pas so// mngon byang lngas bskyed pa'i tshul bsdu na/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa rnal 'byor dang*/ sku spros nas sems can gyi don byed pa rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ skye mched byin gyis brlab pas shin du rnal 'byor dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi sgom pa rnal 'byor chen po ste bzhir bshad pa yang yod de/ dza lan+dha ra pas/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i 'grel par/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*// shin du rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che// zhes gsungs pas so// dus 'khor las ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog dang thig le'i rnal 'byor dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor te sgrub chen bzhi'i tha snyad mdzad/ gzhan yang bskyed tshul la// rdo rje snying 'grel du// rtsa rgyud 'bum lnga'i lung drangs par// lus bskyed pa ni bsnyen par 'gyur// srog 'byung ba ni sgrub pa'o// gnyis skyes sogs rnams slar skye ba// nye ba'i sgrub par brjod par bya// shes rab thabs ni snyoms zhugs pas// sgrub pa chen po tha ma'o// zhes pa skye ba bskyed rim 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis su mdor bsdus pa ni/yang ni stong pa'i byang chub ste// gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu// gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs// bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod// ces gsungs la/ de dag gi don dang mthun par/ dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ da ni dman pa dang mchog gi dbye bas bsnyen pa la sogs pa gsungs pa/ dang por zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ 'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ dang por stong nyid byang chub ces pa ni/ srog chags rnams shi ba'i mthar phung po yongs su dor nas/ skye ba'i cha shas can gyi phung po 'dzin pa las/ bar gang yin pa stong pa nyid kyi skad cig ma gcig po srid pa gsum mthong ba ni stong pa zhes gsungs te/

nges par ni gdon mi za bar ro// skad cig de'i phyi nas zla ba thig le dag ni yang dag 'dzin zhes pa ni/ 'dir kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pas ma'i mngal du khu ba'i thig le rnams 'dzin zhes bya ba ni yang dag 'dzin pa'o// de'i 'og tu khu ba la sogs pa bzung ba de nas gzugs bskyed pa zhes bya ba ni zla ba bdun gyis mngal rdzogs pa ste lus rdzogs pa'o zhes pa'i don no// de nas rab mchog ro'i rigs rnam dag gis shes pa phung po drug po rnams kyis mig la sogs pa rnams kyi yi ge dgod pa ste/ gzugs la sogs pa'i yul la rab tu 'jug pa'o// de bzhin du lha'i sgrub thabs la yang*/ las dang po pas btags pa'i bdag nyid sgom par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ rtsa rgyud 'bum lnga las kyang de lta bur rgyas par bshad pa'i don ni/ dang po stong par sbyang ba ni bar do sbyong byed/ sa bon dgod pa ni mngal du dkar dmar 'phrad pa/ gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa ni mngal du lus rdzogs pa/ yig 'bru dgod pa skye mched gsal bar dod pa/ de dag sbyong byed du lha sgom pa ni/ stong par sbyang ba/ sa bon gdan dang bcas pa/ zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa/ skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'o// pha rgyud rnams las/ 'od gsal stong pa/ gdan pad+ma/ gsung yig 'bru/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad kyang*/ 'dir spros pa de tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas sems can kun rtog la// kun btags lha rnams sgom pa'i don// sems 'dzin phyi nang don shes dang*// dbang 'byor gzhan don gzugs ston phyir// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snod la sbyar ba'i tshul bshad pa'i rjes de nas/ sems can gyi kun rtog gis btags pa las byung ba'i kun btags kyi lha rnams sgom pa'i don ni dgos pa rnam pa gsum gyi phyir te/ las dang po pa rnams kyi sems 'dzin pa'i don dang*/

shes bya shin du phra ba la yang phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi don la sbyar bshad shes dgos pa'i don dang*/ 'bras bu grub pa'i gnas skabs na gdul bya du ma'i ngor gzugs kyi sku dpag tu med pa spro ba la dbang 'byor ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs bshad pa/ lus la dkyil 'khor 'grub tshul kha 'phang ba/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rnam grangs bshad pa/ brjod byed rgyud kyi khyad par bstan pa/ brjod bya bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa bstan pa dang lnga las/ dang po la/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpa' bo gcig nas mtha' yas par// gsungs pa'i nges pa 'di lta ste/ zhes pa yin la/ 'di'i don ni rgyud sde so so nas lha 'khor med pa dpa'o gcig pa nas 'khor mtha' yas pa bye ba phrag du mas bskor ba'i bar gyi/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa rgyud thams cad nas gsungs pa'i nges pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'di man chad du bshad par bya'o// zhes pa'o// rim pa 'di dag ni/ 'dul bya dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi dbang du byas nas/ rab la lha dpa'o gcig pa dang krongs te bskyed pa dang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa sogs bshad la/ 'bring ras ris/ tha ma rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rim pa rnams/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i zhal snga nas/ bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*// de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod// mkhas pa'i sgrub bya de min te// yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro// 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor grub// dkyil 'khor lha rnams grub pa'o// de yi dbang skur la sogs rim// ci nas ma grub yang grub byed/ ces pa dang*/ 'gro ba 'di nyid rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// zhes gsal bar gsungs pa rnams so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/

rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbu ma kun bzhi yang dag don// ye shes rlung dang thig le ni// dpa' bo gcig pa he ru ka// sku gnyis thabs dang shes rab dang*// steng 'og dkar dmar bden gnyis dang*// de sogs yab yum gnyis pa'o// lus ngag yid dang thig le rtsa// steng 'og bar gsum yi ge gsum// rlung gsum sogs phyir lha gsum te// khams bzhi sogs ldan khyab bya bzhi// ye shes lnga dang phung po lnga// 'khor lo rlung dang khyab byed bcas// lha lnga bstan te du mar gsungs// nam mkha' ye shes rnam shes drug /lha drug nyon yid dang bcas bdun// tshogs brgyad sogs phyir brgyad pa dang*// snying ga'i rtsa rlung sa bcu stobs// de sogs dgu dang bcu pa dang*// phung po khams bcu dbang po yul// drug drug de bzhin las byed pa// dbang drug dang bcas dkyil 'khor ni// lha lnga dgu dang bcu gsum dang*// nyer lnga so gnyis so bzhi dang*// so bdun rigs brgya du ma'i bar// rtsa rlung thig le 'khor lo'i grangs// rnam rtog grangs bzhin bstan pa ste// zhal dang phyag mtshan de dang mtshungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa gsungs pa'i nges pa ni/ rtsa dbu ma dang*/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ thams cad la khyab pa'i yang dag pa'i gnas lugs kyi don dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung dang*/ thig le nyag gcig ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ de'i dri ma sbyong bar bya ba'i phyir du lha dpa' bo gcig pa gsungs pa yin zhing*/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dbyer med kyi tshul du khyab pa'i ye shes la/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa he ru ka'i nges par brjod de/ de skad du'ang*/ he ru ka'i don bshad pa na bde mchog dang dgyes rdor gnyis kar/ he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba nyid// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/

dus 'khor gyi ngos 'dzin byed pa'i tshe na/ e gsang mkha' khams bha ga'am// chos 'byung chu skyes seng ge'i khrir// bzhugs pa'i rdo rje can waṃ dang*// rdo rje can dang rdo rje sems// rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang*// he ru ka dang dus 'khor dang*// dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ zhes pa dang*/ kā la tsakra'i sgra don bshad pa na/ spyan ras gzigs kyis/ kā yig las ni rgyu zhi ba// la yig 'di la thim pa nyid// tsa yig gis ni g.yo ba'i sems// kra yig rim pas bcings las so// zhes gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis ni gzhom du med pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po gcig nyid bstan pa'i phyir ro// de'ang lha gtso 'khor gnyis pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes lta bu'i sku gnyis pa can ni/ lus dang bsam pa dang*/ thabs dang shes rab dang*/ yul dang yul can dang*/ rten dang brten pa dang*/ steng 'og dang*/ khams dkar dmar dang*/ lus dang sems dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi bden pa gnyis dang*/ de la sogs pa'i gnyis tshan gyi chos rnams sbyang ba'i phyir du/ lha yab yum gnyis gsungs pa'o// de bzhin du gsum tshan du gsungs pa'i nges pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ rtsa ba spros bral/ 'khrul pa ma rig /gnyen po ye shes kyi thig le gsum dang*/ dbu ma ro brkyang gtso mo gsum ste rtsa gsum dang*/ mkha' spyod/ sa spyod/ sa 'og ste/ steng 'og bar gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum dang*/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyi rlung gsum dang*/ de la sogs pa'i gsum tshan gyi chos mtha' dag sbyang ba'i phyir du lha gtso 'khor gsum pa gsungs pa yin te/ dper na rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub thabs lta bu dang*/ dpal mchog las ming po gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa lta bu'o// de'ang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lung rang 'grel du drangs pa las/ rtsa gsum rlung gsum sems gsum dang*/ snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid phyir// lha gsum yig gsum zhal gsum te/

zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// de bzhin du lha gtso 'khor bzhi gsungs pa'i nges pa ni/ nam mkha' dang ye shes gnyis po khyab byed du btang nas/ khams bzhi la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i khyab bya'i chos bzhi tshan du gsungs pa rnams te/ sa chu me rlung bzhi dang*/ lus ngag sems dang ye shes bzhi dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi dang*/ skad gcig bzhi la sogs pa rnams dag pa'i phyir du/ lha gtso 'khor bzhi pa gsungs te/ dpal mchog las/ sring mo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'o// 'di dag ni/ he badz+ra las/ de ltar thams cad bzhi'o// zhes sbyar nas gsungs pa'i don no// de bzhin du lha gtso 'khor lnga sgom pa'i nges pa yang me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga dang*/ gzugs sogs phung po lnga dang*/ lte snying mgrin pa spyi bo gtsug tor te 'khor lo lnga dang*/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rlung lnga dang*/ khams bzhi'i steng du khyab byed nam mkha' bsnan pa dang bcas pas lnga ste/ lnga tshan gyi chos rnams sbyang ba'i phyir du lha gtso 'khor lnga pa gsungs pa yin te/ rigs lnga dang phag mo lha lnga la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bu grags che ba'i lnga tshan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams so// de bzhin du lha drug gi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i nges pa yang*/ nam mkha' ye shes bsnan pas khams drug dang*/ rnam shes tshogs drug dang*/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo bsnan pas 'khor lo drug la sogs pa drug tshan gyi chos rnams sbyang ba'i phyir du lha gtso 'khor drug pa gsungs te/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug gi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ rdo rje rnam 'joms lha drug gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o// lha bdun sgom pa'i nges pa'ang*// kun gzhi gnas su btang nas/ tshogs drug nyon yid dang bdun sbyang ba'i phyir du bde mchog yi ge bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa lta bu'o// de bzhin du lha brgyad kyi nges pa yang*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad sbyong ba'i phyir du lha brgyad gsungs pa rnams te/

'di ni/ drug pa yid kyi sprul pa ste// dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o// zhes ma rgyud kyi gzhung la lar gsungs pa lta bu la 'grel par bshad/ de bzhin du lha dgu gsungs pa'i nges pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dang*/ de'i yul gcig tu byas pas te dgu dang*/ gzhan yang dgu tshan gyi chos rnams sbyang bar bya ba'i thabs te/ dper na snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad dbus dang dgu sbyang ba'i phyir du dgyes rdor lha dgu gsungs pa lta bu'o// de bzhin du bcu'i nges pa ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung bcu dang sa bcu dang de la sogs pa bcu tshan gyi chos rnams sbyang ba'i phyir du gtso 'khor bcu pa gsungs te/ yang dag gi dkyil 'khor lta bu yin par gsungs so// de bzhin du bco lnga gsungs pa'i nges pa yang*/ phung po lnga dang khams lnga dang dbang po lnga dang bco lnga sbyang ba'i phyir du gtso 'khor bco lnga pa gsungs te/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga lta bu'o// gzhan yang ye shes la sogs pa'i phung po drug dang khams drug dang dbang po drug dang yul drug gi dbye bas/ lha gtso 'khor drug pa gsungs pa dang*/ thabs shes rab kyi dbye bas bcu gnyis pa gsungs pa dang drug tshan gsum sbyang ba'i phyir du gtso 'khor bco brgyad pa dang*/ drug tshan bzhi spyang ba'i phyir du nyer bzhi pa dang*/ ye shes kyi khams dang phung po gnyis gcig tu byas nas nyer gnyis pa dang*/ drug drug gi tshan pa de bzhin du/ sbyang gzhi dang mthun pa'i sbyong bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor/ dbang po drug dang bcas pa la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ de dag la phung po lnga sbyang ba'i lha lnga pa dang*/ nam mkha' ye shes khyab byed du btang ba'i khams bzhi bsnan pas dgu pa dang*/ phung po drug dang*/ khams drug ste bcu gnyis/ dbang po yul snang gcig tu byas pas bcu gsum pa dang*/ phung po lnga khams lnga'i steng du skye mched bcu gnyis dang lus ngag yid gsum bsnan pas nyer lnga pa dang*/

de bzhin du dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dang phung po lnga dang khams lnga'i steng du skye mched bcu gnyis bsnan pas so gnyis pa'am/ mgrin pa dang gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis sbyong ba'i phyir du lha so gnyis pa dang*/ de bzhin du phung khams dbang yul drug tshan du phye ba'i nyer bzhi'i steng du lag pa dang rkang pa dang ngag dang gshang ba'i dbang po dang gci ba'i dbang po dang dbang po mchog ste las dbang drug dang lus ngag sems ye shes bzhi bsnan pas so bzhi pa dang*/ phung khams dbang yul las dbang las kyi dbang po'i bya ba dang bcas pas drug drug so drug gi steng du lus ngag gcig pa nyid bsnan pas so bdun du 'gyur ba dang*/ de bzhin du phung po lnga khams lnga dbang po lnga yul lnga yul can lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga la lus dang bsam pa'i dbye bas lnga bcu/ de la yul dang yul can gyi dbye bas rigs bye ba phrag du ma'i bar du 'gyur ba'ang bshad do// de ltar na/ lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i yan lag gi dbye ba rgyas par bstan pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i tsa rlung thig le 'khor lo'i grangs kyis bstan pa yin te/ de yang dus 'khor las/ rgyu skar gyi chu tshod dang sbyar nas stong drug brgya nyi shu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las dur khrod kyi lha dang bcas pa'i nyis stong brgyad bcu rtsa brgyad lan bcu gnyis su 'khor ba la sogs pa rnams kyang gsungs te/ mdor bsdu na/ sems can gyi rnam rtog gi grangs bzhin du/ de'i gnyen por bstan pa yin te/ de bzhin du zhal dang phyag mtshan la yang*/ zhal gcig pa dang*/ zhal gnyis pa dang*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang*/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa la'ang de bzhin du sbyar tshul shes par bya'o// tshul 'di dag ni/ he badz+ra las/ rigs gcig la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs// rigs kyi tshogs la rigs ni rnam pa brgya// de rnams rigs la 'bum phrag rigs can rnams// bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur// de la grangs med rigs las rigs chen rnams// mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las 'byung ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gnyis pa lus la dkyil 'khor 'grub tshul kha 'phang ba la/

rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus la dkyil 'khor bshad pa ni// phyi rol ji bzhin sa dang thig /dbyibs dang bcas pa bsdus pa ni// kho bos dkyil 'khor snang bar bshad// ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ nang rdo rje'i lus la dkyil 'khor bshad pa ni/ phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dang thig dang gru bzhi la sogs pa'i dbyibs dang bcas pa bsdus pa ni/ kho bos dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos de nyid du bshad zin to zhes pa'i don te/ de yang dkyil 'khor snang ba rang 'grel du drangs pa las/ rkang pa'i zhabs su rtsom chen rlung*// gzhu yi dbyibs su rnam par gnas// shes 'byung ba rims brtsegs dang*/ sin+dhu rdo rje'i thig zlum po// zhes nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su bshad la/ 'di dag gi tshul ni ji skad du sam+bu ṭa las/ lha lags nyan par 'tshal lags na// nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa la// sogs pa'i las ni ji ltar lags// sbyin bsreg las ni mi 'tshal bas// bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol// zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa// he ru ka la sogs pa'i lha// rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag 'byung*// lus kyi dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar// sgo bzhi ji skad gsungs pa'o// rang gi yan lag brgyad byung bas// ka ba de yi bskor nas gnas// shes pa dang*/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung*// gzhu yi dbyibs su rnam par gnas// sum mdo yi ni gnas su ni// de bzhin gru gsum 'bar ba nyid// ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang*// nges brjod las kyang de ltar gsungs shing*/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ ka ba rnams dang rdo rje phreng ba sa yi dkyil 'khor rtsig pa nyid ni rus pa rnams kyi mdzod// sha khrag chu dang gshang ba rnams kyis lha dang gshin rje nor sbyin gzhan du rdul tshon gdab pa ste// mkhris pa bad kan gyis ni nyi ma ri bong can yang de bzhin chu rgyus rnams kyis chu skyes rnams/

ra ba lnga yi re kha sa dang chu dang bsreg za rlung dang nam mkha' las skyes rnams kyis so// dus kyi rtsa yi gtso bo'i chu skyes g.yo ba me yi dkyil 'khor la sogs lpags pa la sogs kyis// nyi ma'i sgo rnams bug pa rnams kyis nor bu'i rang bzhin bkod pa so yi phreng ba de bzhin nyid// dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas rnams ni sor mo rnams kyi sen mo yis// ba spu rnams kyi rdo rje me lce dkyil 'khor gyi ni mtha' ru phyogs dang phyogs bral dag la gnas// de ltar nges par sku yi rdo rje mchog gi yon ltar nges par sku yi rdo rje mchog gi yon tan rnam mang dkyil 'khor gyi ni rnam par gsungs/ shes gsungs pas so// gsum pa thabs dang shes rab kyi rnam grangs bshad pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phan tshun thabs dang shes rab dang*// g.yas g.yon lus sems dkar dmar dang*// rten dang brten pa ma lus pa// thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gsungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba de dag thams cad kyang thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa dang*/ phyir shes bya thams cad kyang bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rnam bzhag bshad na/ phan tshun thabs dang shes rab kyi tshul ni/ gang gi tshe g.yas pa thabs su brjod pa de'i tshe g.yon pa shes rab tu 'gyur zhing*/ gang gi tshe lus sems thabs dang shes rab ni lus thabs su gyur pa na sems shes rab tu 'gyur ba dang*/ dkar dmar thabs dang shes rab ni thabs kyi lus las byung ba'i dkar cha shes rab tu 'gyur ba'i tshe shes rab kyi lus las byung ba'i dmar cha ni thabs su 'gyur ro// rten brten pa'i thabs shes ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams thabs su bshad na/ de la brten pa'i sems can rnams shes rab tu 'gyur ba'o// de phan tshun bzlog nas bshad pa'ang rung ste/

gang gi tshe g.yas phyogs shes rab tu 'gyur ba de'i tshe g.yon pa thabs su 'gyur ba'i phyir tshul de lta bu yang shes par bya'o// rim pa 'di dag la brten nas rgyas gdab kyi tshul thams cad kyang shes par 'gyur te/ dus 'khor las/ shar nub lho byang steng 'og rnams phan tshun mkhyud pas thabs shes su gsungs pa ni/ rigs gzhan gyi rgyas gdab/ rgyu 'bras kyi tshul yang bshad la/ g.yas g.yon rtsa rlung gi rim pa yin pa dang*/ lus la sems kyis rgyas gdab pa ni ma log pa'i rgyas gdab ces bya ste/ rim pa 'di dag ni dgyes rdor las kyang*/ sems lus dang ldan na gnas pa dang*/ lus sems dang ldan na mdzes pa'i phyir/ sku la thugs kyis rgyas gdab pa dang*/ sems la sku yis rgyas gdab pa dang*/ 'dod chags 'od dpag med la ser sna rin 'byung gis rgyas gdab pa dang*/ phrag dog don grub la 'dod chags snang mthas rgyas gdab par gsungs shing*/ dkar dmar dang zla nyi la sogs pa/ bde ba la stong pa/ stong pa la bde ba'i rgyas gdab/ nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin te/ rten dang brten pa rgyu la 'bras bus/ 'bras bu la rgyus/ chu khams la me/ me khams la rlung la sogs pa'i rgyas gdab dpag tu med pa gsungs mod/ de tsam gyi go nus pas 'dir ma spros so// bzhi pa brjod byed rgyud kyi khyad par bstan pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes rab gtsor bstan shes rab rgyud// thabs gtsor bstan pa pha rgyud de// kun kyang gnyis med rang bzhin yin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi rkang grangs ston pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde rnams la/ drang don kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas pa'i dbye ba byas na/ shes rab ste don dam stong nyid kyi cha gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams ni shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ thabs te bskyed rim la sogs pa thabs kyi yan lag gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams ni pha rgyud yin no// zhes 'chad/

rgyud sde'i dbye ba byed pa la las/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang lha la/ pho gtso che ba rnams ni thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ mo gtso che ba rnams ni shes rab kyi rgyud du bshad kyang de dag ma yin pa ni go sla'o// yang la las/ rgyan gyis 'byed par byed de/ pha rgyud la rin po che gtso che ba dang*/ ma rgyud la rus pa'i rgyan gyis khyad par 'byed kyang*/ de yang ma nges so// yang dbye ba byed pa gzhan dag /lha phos zhus pa ni pha rgyud/ mos zhus pa ni ma rgyud du 'dod kyang*/ nges pa med de/ 'dus pa lha mo bzhis zhus dang*/ rtag pa dang po lta bu'o// nges pa'i don du ni/ bla med kyi rgyud sde kun kyang gnyis med kyi rang bzhin du 'dod dgos pa yin te/ thabs shes cha ma snyoms par bshad na/ lam gyi yan lag yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i phyir ro// tshul de dag ni ji skad du/ ma rgyud he badz+ra las/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud// de na nga yis bshad kyis nyon// zhes pa dang*/ pha rgyud du 'dod pa'i 'dus pa'i lung dri med 'od du drangs pa las/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa// rnal 'byor zhes par mngon par brjod// 'dus pa sbyor bar rab gsungs te// sangs rgyas thams cad mngon brjod byed// ces dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ thabs kyi lus kyi rnal 'byor min// shes rab gcig pus 'gyur ma yin// thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa// de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs// shes pa dang*/ he badz+ra las/ gang phyir thabs ni 'byung ba nyid// 'jig pa shes rab srid mthar byed// ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i don no// lnga pa brjod bya bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa bshad pa la/ thabs shes su 'gyur tshul spyir bshad pa dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mig ni thabs te gzugs shes rab// gzugs ni thabs gyur mig shes rab// ro ma thabs te rlung shes rab// brkyang ma shes rab rlung ni thabs// skyes bu thabs te sems shes rab// bud med shes rab sems ni thabs// dbus ni shes rab phyogs ni thabs// don dam thabs te kun rdzob ni// shes rab de bzhin bzlog pa'ang yin// de sogs dpag med shes par bya// kha dog yon tan rim pa rnams// rlung du ji skad bstan bzhin gsungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

'di dag bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las rgyas par 'byung ba'i don mdor bsdus te bstan pa yin pas/ gang gi tshe mig thabs su gyur pa de'i tshe/ gzugs shes rab bo// gang gi tshe gzugs thabs su gyur pa de'i tshe mig shes rab bo// de bzhin sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang chos rnams thabs su gyur ba de'i tshe rna ba la sogs pa shes rab bo// gang gi tshe rna ba la sogs pa thabs su gyur pa de'i tshe sgra la sogs pa shes rab tu 'gyur ba'i tshul rnams kyang shes par bya ste/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ mig sa'i snying por gsungs nas/ gzugs la sogs la sbyor ba sgom// zhes rang 'grel du drangs pa ltar sa snying dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma thabs shes su gsungs pa'ang 'di'i dgongs pa'o// de bzhin du rtsa ro ma thabs su gyur pa na de'i rlung shes rab dang*/ brkyang ma shes rab tu gyur na de las byung ba'i rlung thabs dang*/ skyes bu thabs yin na sems shes rab dang*/ bud med shes rab tu gyur na sems thabs dang*/ dbus shes rab tu song na phyogs rnams thabs dang*/ don dam thabs su song na kun rdzob shes rab tu 'gyur zhing*/ de las bzlog ste/ mig shes rab dang*/ gzugs thabs kyi tshul sngar ltar yang sgom du rung zhing*/ de nyid kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i tshul khong du chud pa yin pas rgyar ma chad pa'i tshul khong du chud par bya ste/ de skad du yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyi lung rang 'grel du drangs pa las/ gang gis rten cing 'brel par 'byung*// thub pas yang dag don du gzigs// de yis 'gro ba stong par mkhyen// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal 'phreng gi mdo rang 'grel du drangs pa las/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la brten nas rnam par grol thob pa 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la 'jug pa'i thabs lags so// zhes gsungs pas so// de lta bu'i tshul la sogs pa dpag tu med par/

thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor tshul de bzhin du brtags nas shes par bya zhing*/ kha dog la sogs pa'i thabs dang shes rab tu 'gyur tshul dang*/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i yon tan rnams ni/ sngar rlung gi skabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin du gsungs pa yin te/ de'ang*/ sa rlung thabs shes/ ser nag thabs shes/ dkar dmar thabs shes la sogs pa yin par go zhing*/ yon tan ni/ chus snum pa la sogs yin par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa bshad pa la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbyibs sku rlung dang brjod pa sngags// yid ni thig le rdzogs rim brjod// skye ba bskyed rim bstan pa ste// 'chi ba rdzogs rim nyid yin no// kun btags bskyed rim zhes bya ste// gzhan dbang 'brel pa rdzogs rim bshad// bden gnyis thabs rnams bskyed rim ste// dbyer med shes rab rdzogs rim gsungs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de la bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ thog mar stong pa las/ sa bon phyag mtshan bsgyur nas dbyibs zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi sku bskyed pa dang*/ rlung la brten nas sgra bcas kyi brjod pa sngags kyi bzlas pa gang yin pa de dag ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ zab pa'i bskyed rim gyi dbang du byas na/ sgra med kyi bzlas pa la brten pa dang*/ thig le dang nā da la dmigs nas sems 'dzin pa'ang yod de/ bskyed rim gyi sgra bshad na/ byis pa rim gyi skye ba dang chos mthun par/ gdan sa bon las sku yongs su rdzogs par rim gyi bskyed pa'i don gyis na bskyed rim zhes bya'o// 'o na krongs te bskyed pa la sgra mi 'jug par 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'gal ba med de/ kun slong las rim gyi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ sngon gyi las las grub pa'i sbyang gzhi dang mthun pa'i phyir/ rdzogs rim gyi sgra don ni/ rim pa ltar du/ snod bcud la sems bsdus nas thig le dang nā da las rim gyis kha dog dang dbyibs dang*/

bzlas pa'i rim pa rnams rim gyi 'gags te rdzogs nas// dmigs med kyi ngang du 'jog pa'i rim pa la brjod de/ 'di la'ang rdzogs rim zhes pa'i sgra bshad na/ dmigs pa'i yul rags pa spros bcas rnams rim gyis 'gags te rdzogs nas/ spros med la 'jog pa'i rim pa yin pa'i don gyis na/ rdzogs rim zhes bya'o// 'di la mi zab pa rtog bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ zab pa spros med kyi rdzogs rim gnyis yod do// bskyed rim gyi tshul 'di dag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'grel chen du/ 'dir mngal gyi lus bskyed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lha bskyed pa la dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang bsnyen pa'i yan lag go// ngag bskyed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du las rgyal mchog dang nye ba'i sgrub pa'o// byang chub sems kyi thig le bskyed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du thig le'i rnal 'byor dang sgrub pa'o// khu ba 'pho ba na bde ba bskyed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bsgrub pa chen po ste/ de ltar yan lag bzhi'i sgrub pa nang gi le'u las sngar gsungs pa rgya cher sbyang bar bya'o zhes pa ni nges pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de yang 'jig rten gyi chags 'jig thams cad dang*// bden gnyis rnams bskyed rdzogs la sbyar na// skye ba bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin pas bskyed rim zhes brjod la/ 'chi ba rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin pas/ de'i tha snyad rdzogs rim nyid yin par brjod cing*/ kun btags ni bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin pas bskyed rim zhes bya ste/ rtog pas sgro btags nas lha'i dbyibs sgom pa'i phyir/ gzhan dbang ni rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi dang 'brel bas rdzogs rim zhes bya ste/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i phyi rol gyi sems bsdus nas nang du thig le dang nā da la brten nas rnam par shes pa tsam la sems 'dzin pa'i phyir/

kun rdzob kyi bden pa la bskyed rim zhes bya ste/ bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin zhing*/ bskyed rim 'grub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i phyir/ don dam gyi bden pa la rdzogs rim zhes bya ste/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgoms pa la brten nas spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i gzhom med kyi don dam bden pa khong du chud pa'i phyir/ de'ang bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa'i thabs rnams ni bskyed pa'i rim pa yin te/ ye shes kyi yon tan thams cad rim gyi bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// bden gnyis dbyer med kyi shes rab ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin te/ bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer med bsgoms pa la brten nas spros med don dam pa'i bden pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po la 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni rnal 'byor ma kun du spyod pa'i rgyud las/ thams cad bden pa gnyis la ni/ brten par ngas ni sngon bshad pa/ rnal 'byor pa yis dngos grub kyis// sgom pa mngon dgar gyur pa yin// spros pa kun la dmigs nas ni// spros pas spros pa med par bya// rgyud rnams kun du gsang ba gang*// sprul pa rnams kyi de nyid bstan// rgyud 'di yis ni rnal 'byor ba// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// zhes pa dang*/ sbyang gzhi ni rgyud bla ma las// ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do// zhes gsungs pas/ gnas skabs su phung po lnga ga sbyang gzhir gsungs kyang*/ don la ni rang bzhin 'od gsal bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po kho na sbyang gzhir 'dod dgos pa yin no// gsum pa don bsdu ba la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de la sogs pa thams cad kyang*// phyi dang nang dang gzhan gyi rim// ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba ni// rtsa ba mdor bsdus brjod pa yin// ji ltar e waṃ bshad pa bzhin// shes bya 'dzin med ngang du sbyang*// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

de ltar bshad pa'i thabs shes su sbyor tshul dang*/ bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i rim pa thams cad kyang phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rim pa la sbyor tshul dang*/ thams cad gnas lugs kyi ye shes nyag cig tu sbyor ba'i tshul ni rtsa ba mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig 'dir brjod pa yin gyi/ de ltar shes bya'i rnam bzhag la rgyas par dbye na dpag tu med kyang*/ gnas lugs mdor bsdu na/ gnas tshul bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po gcig nyid du 'dus pa yin te/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo rgyud rnams las gsungs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i chos thams cad bsdu na/ e waṃ gyi yi ge gnyis su 'dus par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mdor na rnal 'byor pas/ bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya thams cad la so sor 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog spangs nas spros bral 'dzin med kyi ngang la sbyangs na yang dag pa'i bden pa khong du chud par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i don to// e waṃ gyi yi ge gnyis po'i tshul ni/ he badz+ra las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// e waṃ rnam pa bde chen po// dbang las yang dag shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las// e waṃ zhes bya yi ge gnyis// e ni stong pa nyid du bshad// de bzhin waṃ ni thugs rje dang*// thig le de nyid sbyor las byung*// de ni rnal 'byor rmad mchog byung*// e waṃ gnyis ni sangs rgyas dang*// mdor bsdus chos kyi phyag rgya'o// rgyal po chen po phyag rgya gnyis// rgyud rnams su ni thog ma gsungs// shes pa dang*/ gnyis med ye shes mtshan ma ni// rgyud kun gyi ni gleng gzhir gsungs/ shes pa dang*/ e waṃ zhes bya'i yi ge gnyis// gang la 'di gnyis med pa ni// de la de kho na nyid med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ de'i rgyas bshad du/ yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dag pa sbyar nas gsungs te/

de dag ni/ e waṃ ma yā shu taṃ laṃ e ka smin na ma ye bha ga wān sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta hri da ya badz+ra yo ṣī bha ge ṣu ni dza hā ra/ zhes pa ste don brjod na/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so// zhes pa ste/ 'di la rgyud las/ e ni shes rab dam pa ste/ 'dod chags bral sogs skad gcig bdag /srid pa gsum na yongs shes pa// 'di ni rtsa bar rnam par bstan/ zhes sogs yi ge re re la'ang don bshad rgyas par gsungs kyang*/ don la dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyang yi ge 'di dag las bzhengs pa'i tshul ni/ gong du e waṃ gyi skabs su samū ṭa nas gsungs pa'i yi ge dang sbyar nas bshad pa ltar ro// phreng bar yi ge 'di dag gi don bshad pa'i rjes su/ 'di skad la sogs dang po'i ngag /mchog tu gsungs pa'i don rgyas pa// gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo// de nyid bshad pa bsdus pa ni// rim pa ji lta ba bzhin shes// shes gsungs so// de tsam gyis e waṃ gyi don rags pa go nus pas rgyas par ma spros pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don rgyas par bshad pa las kun btags kyi lha 'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa ste brgyad pa'o// zhes so// kun btags bskyed rim sgom pa'i dgos pa dang*// sbyang gzhi dang mthun so so'i lha grangs dang*// phan tshun thabs shes bskyed rdzogs sgom pa'i tshul// rtog med e waṃ sgom tshul legs par bshad// ces pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba las kun btags kyi lha sgom pa'i tshul rnam par bshad pa ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //dgu pa chos rnams kyi sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed bstan pa'i le'u la/

dngos dang*/ le'u'i mtshan bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ de nas chos rnams thams cad kyi// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gsungs pa yi// nges pa 'dir ni bstan par bya/ zhes pa ste/ de ltar kun btags kyi lha sgom pa'i le'u bshad pa'i rjes de nas/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs kyi chos thams cad kyi sbyang gzhi don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ sbyang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang*// sbyong byed lam gyi rim pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras sku dang ye shes su gsungs pa rnams le'u dgu pa 'dir bstan par bya'o// zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ yang dag pa'i bden pa gnyis bshad pa/ bden pa gnyis ma shes pa'i log rtog dgag /spang gnyen gyi rtsa ba mdor bstan/ gnyen po rgyud sde'i nges pa bye brag tu bshad// dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs rtsa khams dang sbyar ba dang lnga/ dang po la/ bden gnyis kyi ngo bo ngos bzung*/ de gsang ba 'dus pa'i lung dang sbyar ba/ de la brten nas gnyen po ye shes skye ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po la/ spyi'i don dang*/ yan lag gzhung gi don rnam pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag spyir bshad pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi bden gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir sems can thams cad 'khor bar yang nas yang du 'khor zhing bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khrul pa'i rgyu ni/ bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs ma shes pa'i dbang gis 'khrul pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan don dam pa'i bden pa ni ma rtogs shing*/ rang gi bag chags kyi dbang gis snang ba'i kun rdzob slu ba'i chos can la bden par 'dzin pa'i dbang gis slar yang 'khor bar 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ dper na byis pa 'ga' zhig gis sngar rang nyid kyis mi gtsang ba'i 'dam chen po g.yos te/ phyis rang nyid der lhung pa la byed po gzhan med pa lta bu dang*/

yang ri mo mkhan mkhas pas thog mar rang nyid kyis sems can gyi srog la za ba'i gnod sbyin gyi gzugs chen po 'jigs shing ya nga ba dran pa tsam gyis brgyal zhing 'bog par nus pa bris nas/ phyis ma brtags par rang nyid kyis gzugs de mthong ba'i tshe na skrag cing 'gyel bar 'gyur ba la byed pa po gzhan med par 'gyur ba lta bu yin te/ de skad du'ang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma nyi shu pa rang 'grel du drangs pa las/ sgyu ma ji lta ji lta bar/ de bzhin sems can yul la spyod// 'gro ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin sbyong*// de bzhin du ni brten nas byung*// ji ltar ri mo mkhan gyis gzugs// gnod sbyin 'jigs pa bris pa yis// de yis bdag nyid skrag pa ltar// mi mkhas 'khor bar de bzhin no// ji ltar rang gis 'dam g.yos pas// byis pa 'ga' zhig bying ba ltar// de bzhin rtog pa'i 'dam bying bas// sems can rnams ni 'byung mi nus// dngos med dngos por lta ba yis// sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong*// yul dang shes pa de dag tu// rnam par rtog pa'i dug gis bcings// shes gsungs pas/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta dang glang po dang shing rta dang khrom mang po la sogs pa dag la ni/ sems dang 'du shes dang lus su grub pa med kyang*/ sman dang sngags kyis bslad pa bzhugs pa'i skyes pa dang bud med rnams ni rta dang glang po la sogs par snang zhing snang ba po dang der zhen par byed/ sgyu ma mkhan rang nyid kyis ni sman dang sngags kyis bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs/ der mi zhen pa bzhin du/ ma rig pa'i bslad bzhugs pa'i sems can rnams ni/ kun rdzob 'jig rten gyi snang ba la dgra gnyen dang yid du 'ong mi 'ong sogs la blang dor byed cing zhen la/ chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul las gzhan du ma grub par shes pa'i mkhas pa de kho na nyid lta ba'i mig dang ldan pa dag gis ni zhen par mi byed pa yang tshul de lta bu yin no// de la kun rdzob bden pa'i sgra don ni/

sam̐ bṛ ta zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ yang dag pa'i gnas tshul la sgrib par byed/ 'gebs par byed pa'i don du bshad pa yin te/ de skad du yang dbu ma 'jug pa las/ gti mug rang bzhin sgrib phyir kun rdzob ste// des gang bcos ma bden par snang de ni// kun rdzob bden zhes thub pa des gsungs te// zhes gsungs pas so// des na kun rdzob ni mthong ba brdzun pas rnyed pa'am// rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba ni kun rdzob kyi don yin no// de la yang*/ chos kyi gnas tshul shes pa'i 'phags pa la sgyu ma lta bur snang ba 'phags pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ gnas tshul la rmongs pa'i byis pa so so skye bo la rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod ltar snang ba ni byis pa'i kun rdzob/ phyi ma 'di la yang tha snyad du chur snang yang chu'i don byed mi nus pa log pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ tha snyad du chu'i don byed nus pa yang dag pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su gsungs te/ 'di dag ni dbu ma 'jug pa las/ dngos kun yang dag brdzun pa mthong ba yis// dngos snyed ngo bo gnyis ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ mthong ba brdzun pa'ang rnam pa gnyis 'dod de/ dbang po gsal dang dbang po skyon ldan no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos bden gnyis las/ ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na// kun rdzob gzhan ni gcig shos yin// zhes pa dang*// snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir// yang dag yang dag ma yin pas// kun rdzob gyi ni dbye ba byas// shes gsungs pas so// mdor na kun rdzob kyi bden pa thams cad ni tha snyad du snang tsam ma gtogs/ don gyi steng nas yang dag pa'i tshad ma'i ngor ma grub par 'dod dgos pa yin te/ de skad du yang*/ dbus mtha' las/ don dang sems can bdag rnam rig /snang ba'i rnam par shes pa ni// rab tu skye'o de don med// de med pas na de yang med/ ces kun btags kyi cha dang kun rdzob kyi cha rnams rnam pa thams cad du gtan med pa nyid du gsungs pa'i phyir/

'o na med na bden par ci ltar bzhag ce na/ de ni blo kun rdzob pa 'khrul pa'i ngo bor bden pa'i don gyis na bden pa zhes brjod pa yin gyi/ 'gyur med kyi bden pa ni ma yin pa'i phyir skyon med do// don dam pa'i sgra don ni// par mār+tha zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ don yang yin/ dam pa'ang yin pa'i don gyis na don dam par 'jog te/ 'di'i bden pa ni 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi ngor bden pa'o// de la don dam bden pa'i don ldog ni/ mthong ba yang dag pas rnyed pa'i rnyed don nam/ rang bzhin spros bral gang zhig yongs gcod du shes brjod gzhal bya las 'das pa'i don yin te/ de skad du yang dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab las/ gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang*// spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa// rnam rtog med don tha dad med// de ni de nyid mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar bden pa gnyis rnam par bzhag pa la rgyu mtshan yod pa yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad bden pa gnyis po 'di gnyis la brten nas/ drang don dang*/ nges don gyi sgo nas rnam par bzhag par 'chad dgos pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de skad du yang rtsa ba shes rab las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// gang dag bden pa 'di gnyis kyi// rnam dbye rnam par mi shes pa// de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa ni// zab mo'i de nyid rnam mi shes// shes gsungs pa dang*/ de'i 'grel ba slob dpon klu sgrub rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ga la 'jigs med las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos bstan pa ni bden pa gnyis po 'di dag la brten nas 'byung ste/ 'jig rten pa'i kun rdzob kyi bden pa zhes bya ba ni/ chos rnams ngo bo nyid stong pa dag la 'jig rten gyi phyin ci log ma gtogs pas/

chos thams cad skye bar mthong ba gang yin pa ste/ de ni de dag nyid la/ kun rdzob tu bden pa nyid yin pas kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o// don dam pa'i bden pa ni/ 'phags pa rnams kyis phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud pas chos thams cad skye ba med par gzigs pa gang yin pa ste/ de ni de dag nyid la don dam par bden pa nyid yin pas don dam pa'i bden pa'o// de la gang dag kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa de gnyis kyi rnam par dbye ba de ltar rnam par mi shes pa de dag ni sangs kyi bstan pa zab mo'i de nyid rnam par mi shes pa yin no// zhes gsungs pas so// de la kha cig 'di snyam du/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa gzhi ma grub cing don dam pa'i bden pa kho na yod na/ don dam bden pa gcig nyid bstan pas chog gi/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa bstan pa la dgos pa med do snyam na de ni ma yin te/ thog mar tha snyad kun rdzob kyi bden pa ma bstan par don dam bden pa rtogs mi nus shing*/ don dam bden pa ma rtogs par mya ngan las 'das pa thob mi nus pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang rtsa ba shes rab las/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni bstan mi nus// dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang*// don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur pa ste// de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis mi shes pa// de ni rnam rtog log pas lam ngan zhugs/ shes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang mthun par bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag rags pa tsam zhig bshad pa yin no// gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la/ 'khrul ba'i snang ba thams cad ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden par 'chad pa dbu ma pa dang mthun zhing*/ rnam rtog gi ngo bor/ dag pa lha sku'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba yang kun rdzob kyi bden par 'dod dgos la/

nang du ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis sha'i mig gam rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum gyi stobs kyis nam mkhar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po mngon sum du mthong ba'i du ba la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni don dam bden pa yin par bshad/ mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la/ yang dag pa'i 'bras bu ye shes dang de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnyen po lam gyi ye shes dang*/ de dag 'byung ba'i rgyu/ gzhi dus kyi khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dbyer med pa'i ye shes nyid don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ rgyu rgyud lam rgyud 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi ngo bor 'dod pa ni/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i rnam bzhag yin pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin par 'dod dgos so// 'di'i skabs kyi rang 'grel du/ don dam par na rgyu dang 'bras bu dang lam du nye bar 'dogs pa dang sems pa dang rtog pa dag gi rnam par rtog pas sgro btags pa tsam ste don la yod pa ma yin no// 'o na don dam par gang zhig yod na/ rtog pa'i dra ba thams cad las 'das pa'i sems rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i sems can gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi snying po dag ni yod pas/ shes gsungs so// de dag ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// bzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs shing*// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis byang chub sems 'grel du// de'i don 'chad par bzhed nas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing*// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ ces de lta bu de la/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi ming gis bstan zhing*// 'di la bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar// bdag gi de kho na nyid kyi tha snyad dang*// a ham̐ gi sgras bstan pa yang yod de/

de skad du'ang*/ de nyid las/ bdag ces bya ba sgra yis bstan// gang gis yang dag shes pa yis// srid pa'i 'ching ba'i mtshan nyid ni// a ham̐ 'khor lo'i 'ching ba dag /ces dang*/ a ni dngos po kun gyi mchog /lus rnams kun la lhag par gnas// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan// kun khyab kun mkhyen zad pa med/ ces gsungs pas/ a'i don sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i rgyud kyi ngo bo dang*/ ham̐ gi don ni/ de'i ngo bo la rang bzhin gyi dri mas ma gos shing*/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang ma 'dres par gnas pa'i don du bshad de/ de nyid las/ ham̐ ni dngos po dang bral ba// lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min// dngos po las 'das mi gsal ba// rnam pa thams cad rnam par spangs// shes pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi don bsdus su// a ham̐ dngos po thams cad la// khyab pa yis ni lhag par gnas// a ham̐ dang bral skyes bu ni// rtsa ba bcad pa'i shing bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas so// dus 'khor las ni/ 'di sbyang ba'i thabs gsungs pa na/ rnal 'byor pa gang gis bskyed rdzogs kyi lam bsgoms nas gnas skabs bzhi'i 'khrul pa dag ste/ chos sku mngon du mdzad pa'i tshe na/ de lta bu'i chos sku de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku dang dbyer med kyi tshul du 'gyur te/ dper na sa'i phyogs 'ga' zhig tu bum pa yod pa las/ re shig bum pa'i nang gi thad kyi nam mkha' de nyi tshe ba yin kyang*/ bum pa g.yas g.yon du khyer ba'i tshe na/ de'i thad kyi nam mkha' g.yas g.yon du 'gro ba ma yin pa dang*/ gal te bum pa bcag pa'i tshe na/ de'i thad kyi nam mkha' mi chag cing logs su ngos bzung med par nam mkha' dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba bzhin du rang bzhin 'od gsal bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po des kyang sems can thams cad la khyab nas yod cing*/ nam mkha' gzugs can thams cad la zhugs pa'i dpes/ de la mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje zhes pa'i tha snyad dang brjod pa yin te/

de skad du'ang bsdus rgyud las/ bdag ni byed po sdug bsngal bde ba rab tu sbyin par mi yi bdag po der ni 'gyur ba yin/ 'ga' yang bcings dang grol bar 'gyur min mi yi bdag po sems kyi nus pa rnam par spangs nas so// nam mkha' bum pa'i dbus nas chu ni len par byed pa na yang 'gro ba min pa ji lta ba/ mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje can ni yul dang rnam bral lus kyi dbus ngag du yang de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel las kyang de ltar gsungs pas so// des na sems 'od gsal gcig nyid la sgrib pa dang bcas pa'i tshe na sems can dang*/ khams sbyong byed kyi lam sgom pa'i tshe na byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dag pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshe na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i tha snyad btags te/ dper na chu rngul dang bcas pa'i tshe na rnyog ma dang*/ rdul dang bral ba'i tshe na chu dwangs par 'jog kyang*/ chu'i ngo bo mi 'gyur ba dang*/ de bzhin du chu dro grang du gyur ba'i tshe na ming so sor 'dogs kyang chu'i ngo bo mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dri ma med pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba yang*/ sgra gcan gyi gdong dang khug sna la sogs pa'i sgrib pa lngas bsgribs kyang rang gi ngo bo mi 'gyur ba bzhin/ sems la yang 'dod chags gnod sems le lo sogs kyi bsgribs kyang ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pa yin no// zhes dpe dang bcas te bstan pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las// de bzhin sa bon thams cad las// rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*// sa bon med par 'bras yod par// shes ldan gang gis sgrub par nus// sa bon gyur pa khams de nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rten du 'dod// rim gyi sbyangs par gyur pa las// sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyur// dri med nyi ma zla ba yang*// sprin dang du ba khug sna dang*// sgra gcan gdong dang rdul la sogs// sgrib pa lnga yis bsgribs par gyur// de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems// 'dod dang gnod sems le lo dang*// rgod pa dang ni the tshom ste// sgrib pa lnga yis bsgribs par gyur// ji ltar me yis dag pa'i gos// sna tshogs dri mas dri ma can// ji ltar me yi nang bcug na// dri ma 'tshig 'gyur gos min ltar// de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma can// ye shes me yis nyon mongs bsreg

/de nyid 'od gsal ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas so// de la kha cig na re/ de lta bu'i rang bzhin 'od gsal 'gyur med yod na/ yum gyi mdo las/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni mi 'gal te/ der gsungs pa de dag ni/ khams la sgrib byed kyi dri ma kun rdzob pa'i cha nyon mongs pa can dang*/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa rnams la bden brdzun 'gog pa yin gyi/ sems 'od gsal 'gog pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de skad du yang chos dbyings bstod pa las/ stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo// rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa gang*// de dag kun gyis nyon mongs bzlog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ nyon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yi// las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin// zhes sogs gsungs pas so// khams de nyid la ming gi rnam grangs ni// chos sku dang de bzhin nyid dang rigs gsum gyi tha snyad mdzad de/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste/ zhes gsungs so// 'di dag gi rnam par bzhag pa rgyas par ni/ gong du rgyu rkyen spyir bstan pa'i skabs su bshad zin pas 'dir re shig spros pa de tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems can khams ni sangs rgyas kyi// snying po dri med bden gnyis ldan// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dir sbyang gzhi'i ngo bo ni/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po gang yin pa ste/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi snying po ngo bo rang bzhin gyi dri ma med cing*/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i don gyis na kun rdzob kyi bden pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bo rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i spros bral don dam pa'i bden pa yin pas na bden pa gnyis dang ldan pa ste/

de'ang ma dag pa'i sems can rnams kyis 'khrul pa'i cha ngos ma zin pas/ slar yang de la zhen cing rjes su zhugs nas 'khor ba len par byed cing 'phags pa rnams kyis de kho na nyid kyi bdud rtsi blangs nas myang 'das chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa yin no zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa lung dang sbyar ba la yang*/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ru// kun rdzob bzung 'dzin snang ba ste// bden pa chu zla lta bu'o// don dam stong nyid bco brgyad de// bden pa gnyis med ye shes brjod// ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i bden pa gnyis kyi tshul 'di ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud de ru/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa thams cad ni bzung 'dzin gnyis su 'khrul pa'i snang ba ste/ de'i bden pa ni chu'i zla ba lta bu don la ma grub pa'i dpe dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa stong pa nyid bco brgyad du gsungs pa ste/ de'i bden pa ni/ yul dang yul can dbyer med pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes la brjod do zhes so// 'di dag ni ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ ji skad du/ bden pa rnam pa gnyis kyi dgongs pa ni 'di lta ste/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa'o// rigs kyi bu kun rdzob ni mi brtan pa dang g.yo ba'o// de'i bden pa ni chu zla lta bu'o// don dam pa'i bden pa ni stong pa chen po bco brgyad do// de'i mtha' ni gnas so// zhes gsungs pa'i don to// de dag ni/ kun rdzob dang don dam so sor phye nas/ don dam bden pa 'chad pa'i skabs su// stong nyid bco brgyad po yul yul can gnyis ka la/ de dang de'i ming gis bstan pa ste// rdo rje phreng ba las snod gyi 'jig rten dang bral ba// chen po stong pa nyid du brjod// ye shes gang gis de stong par// mthong ba de yang stong par brjod// ces gsungs pas so// gsum pa gnyen po ye shes skye tshul la/

rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de rtog byed pa'i rtog pas bskyed// gnyen po sbyong byed yin par bshad// sbyang gzhi'i grangs bzhin chos kun bstan// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bden pa gnyis kyi gnas tshul la log par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa gang la ci lta ba bzhin du ma grub pa la grub pa der rtog par byed pa'i rnam par rtog pas bskyed nas/ sbyang gzhi de la sgrib par byed pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing*/ de sbyong bar byed pa'i gnyen po ni gong du bshad pa'i mos pa la sogs pa rnams yin par bshad la/ mdor bsdu na/ sbyang gzhi'i chos phung khams skye mched nyon mongs pa ji snyed yod pa de nyid kyi grangs bzhin/ 'bras bu thob pa de'i tshe na/ yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cu la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i tshul yang*/ bla na med pa'i rgyud sde dang nges don gyi mdo sde'i chos kun las bstan pa yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa bden gnyis ma shes pa'i log rtog dgag pa la/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i log rtog dgag pa dang*/ rang sde nyan thos pas btags pa'i log rtog dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ phyi rol pas btags pa'i grub mtha' ngos bzung ba dang*/ de ji ltar 'khrul ba'i tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa tshig gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshangs sogs grub mtha' thams cad kyang*// rnam rtog gis byas shes bya yin// rgyu rkyen ldan dang med 'dzin sogs// shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ mu stegs tshangs pa lhar 'dzin pas tshangs pa ba dang*/ khyab 'jug lhar 'dzin pas khyab 'jug pa dang*// dbang phyug lhar 'dzin pas dbang phyug pa dang*/ lha'i bla ma drang srong phur bu'i grub mtha' smra ba dang*/ rā ma na dang*/ grangs can pa dang*/ nam mkha' gos su gyon pa'i gcer bu ba rnams kyi grub pa'i mtha' thams cad kyang yang dag pa ma yin te/

rang rang gi rnam rtog gis log par btags nas byas pa yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shes par bya ba tsam zhig yin pa la ni 'gal ba med kyang*/ de dag gi rjes su zhen cing 'jug tu rung ba ni ma yin no// de dag gi grub mtha' ni tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug la sogs pas byas pa'i rgyu rkyen dang ldan par 'dod pa'i grub mtha' dang*/ chos thams cad rgyu med ngo bo nyid kyis byung zhing*/ 'jig rten pha rol med par 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i grub mtha' ni dpag tu med do// zhes pa'i don te/ de dag gi grub pa'i mtha' ni rim pa bzhin du/ dang po rig byed la brten pa'i mchod sbyin byed pa po tshangs pa pa rnams kyi grub pa'i mtha' ni/ mchod sbyin dang snyan dngags dang nges brjod dang srid bsrungs te/ rig byed kyi bstan bcos bzhi po/ byed pa po med cing rang byung nam mkha' lta bur 'dod pa dang*/ skye bo thams cad kyang tshangs pa chen po'i kha lag rkang pa sogs las byung bar 'dod pa ste/ de'ang*/ bram ze tshangs pa'i kha'i skyes gnas can yin pas kha dog dkar zhing rig pa gsal ba can du 'dod/ rgyal rigs lag pa las skyes pas kha dog dmar zhing dpa' bar 'dod/ rje rigs ni brla gnyis las skyes par 'dod cing kha dog ser po/ tshong sogs la mkhas shing nor phun sum tshogs par 'dod/ dmangs rigs ni rkang pa las skyes shing zhing las dang rgyal po'i 'khor g.yog byed par 'dod/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ni/ a shwa min dha ste/ rta'i mchod sbyin kho na dge ba thams cad kyi mchog yin par 'dod/ blo chos su smra ba rig pa can pa khyab 'jug gi 'dod pa ni/ brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten thams cad khyab 'jug gis byas par 'dod pa dang*/ dge mi dge'i las yod cing dus gsum thams cad rtag par smra ba dang*/ snying stobs dang rdul dang mun pa gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pa dang*/ stong pa nyid zhig pa'i chos nyid yod pa dang*/

dge mi dge lung ma bstan byed pa'i 'bras bu bde sdug btang snyoms su yod par 'dod pa rnams ni khyab 'jug gi 'dod pa'o// 'khrig pa chos su smra ba dbang phyug pa'i 'dod pa ni lam drug 'dod pa khyab 'jug pa dang mthun zhing*/ lam drug ni mtho ris gsum dang ngan song gsum 'dod pa dang*/ bye brag tu 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po dbang phyug yin par smra zhing*/ de'i tshul yang*/ dbang phyug rdza mkhan lta bur sna tshogs 'di nyid sprul pa byed par ma grub na/ sa gzhi 'di mi 'grub cing ri rab 'di min rgya mtsho ma yin te// nyi zla skar ldan bkod pa 'di dag mig yul du ni mi 'gyur la// yod pa'i phyir na dbang phyug 'gro ba bde bar 'gyur ba'i byed po yin/ zhes 'dod cing*/ de yang lngas te/ nam mkha' la sogs pa'i khams dang*/ drug pa ye shes kyi khams dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi khams 'dod pa'i de kho na nyid dang*/ bdag gi de kho na nyid dang*/ zhi ba'i de kho na nyid de de nyid gsum dang*/ gong bu tshig dang gzugs la gnas pa ste/ lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ gzhan yang dbang phyug gis sgra bsgrags pa'i rgyud du'ang*/ lha mo rin chen gnas 'di ni/ dbang phyug drag dang mi ldan mchog /lte bar chu ni song ba ste// mtshon bya mtshon byed las des grol// zhes 'byung bar 'dod pa dang*/ sems can mtha' dag gi lus la dbang phyug gis khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ srog chags rnams kyi lus la gnas pa'i khyim bcu gnyis po rnams la/ dbang phyug gis 'dud pa'i dbang gis 'byung bar 'dod pa la sogs pa ni dbang phyug pa'i grub mtha'o// tsa ru ka pa ste tshu rol mdzes par smra ba rnams kyi 'dod pa ni/ lus can rnams la byed pa po med cing las bsags kyang las kyi rnam par smin pa skye ba phyi ma la med pa dang*/ sems can thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i tshogs pa las byung ba dang*/ dper na a ru ra dang*/

bu ram gyi shing la sogs pa yang dag par sbyar ba las chang gi nus pa 'byung ba yin no// zhes bya ba ni rgyang 'phen pa'i gtso bo lha'i bla ma drang srong phur bu pa'i bzhed pa'o// kla klo stag gzig pa'i ston pa rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dngos po thams cad sog por rah+ma nas byas shing*/ bde sdug thams cad kyang rah+ma na dga' ba dang mi dga' ba'i byed pa las 'byung bas/ kho la mchod sbyin byas na dga' ba las mtho ris dang*/ mi dga' ba las ngan song du 'gyur bar 'dod/ gzhan yang mu stegs kyi bye brag mchod 'os pa'am/ rgyal ba pa'am/ mkha' gos can nam/ gcer bu pa zhes ming gi rnam grangs su bstan pa rnams kyi 'dod pa ni/ rtag pa dang mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i tha snyad khas len zhing*/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum dang*/ srog gang zag dus/ nam mkha'/ bsod nams/ sdig pa ste rdzas drug dang*/ srog lus kyi cha shas su 'dod cing*/ srog dus nam mkha' gsum ni rtag gzhan rnams ni mi rtag /kha zas kyi lus dang*/ 'od kyi lus dang*/ rang bzhin can gyi lus dang*/ rdzus skyes kyi lus dang*/ mtha'i lus shes/ yid du 'ong ba'i srog gi rten dang*/ brtul zhugs/ sdom pa/ grogs/ ye shes/ spyod pa dag gi dbye bas/ shes pa'i don brtul zhugs lnga ni/ 'tshe ba med pa dang*/ bden smra/ byin pa/ len pa/ tshangs spyod/ gtong ba dang lngar bshad/ sdom pa lnga ni/ gcer bu'i spyod lam/ smra bcad/ tshol ba/ blang ba/ chung ma zos pa// chos shes kyi nye bar gnas pa/ dmyal ba dud 'gro mi lha thar pa'i 'gro ba lnga/ blo gros dang*/ thos dang*/ 'chi dus dang*/ rtog dpyod/ mo rtsis kyi ye shes lnga/ gzhan yang srog lus kyi tshad dang*/ thar pa'i tshad steng du gdugs dkar po bkan pa'i dbyibs lta bur 'dod pa ni zad byed pa rnams kyi grub pa'i mtha'o// de dag sun 'byin pa na 'grel chen du/ bram ze kha las skyes na pho mo thams cad ming sring du 'gyur ba'i phyir/
